FEAT-3-S73.title: Clinical Trials Tool Router Exposure
FEAT-3-S73.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowed tool via tool_router, including input validation enforcement, tool registration, and response serialization for LLM consumption.

FEAT-3-S74.title: Clinical Trials Service Error Handling and Fallbacks
FEAT-3-S74.description: Implement robust error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API failures, including timeout handling, partial results return, and safe fallback messaging when distance or trial data is unavailable.

FEAT-3.mitigation: Return partial results when external APIs fail; avoid blocking full response
